sections.title: What changed
items: Adventure Quest works just as before: this release updates the built-in code every Snug app uses to talk to Snug to the version new apps are built with.
Customized your copy? You can skip this one — your version keeps working as it is.

sections.title: What's new
items: The quest ships its wiki: vision, requirements, plan, lessons, and next tasks, editable in your copy.
The prompt that would rebuild it is included, honestly labeled a retrospective reconstruction.

sections.title: What's new
items: The agent tells a tale that adapts to your choices.
Your pack and progress persist in a real database inside your file.
